description: Verifies the headless compute pipeline on a 64 by 64 Schwarzschild frame at r = 15: device initialization with native double precision, complete pixel processing with horizon and celestial pixels, agreement of the pixel classification between the FP64 pipeline and the single-precision software path above 98 percent, and the agreement of an emulated double-single trajectory with native double precision.

checks.label: the device supports native double precision
every pixel of the frame is processed
the black hole absorbs some rays
some rays escape to the sky
more than 98 percent of the pixel classifications agree between the two paths
the double-single radius matches native double precision within a relative 1e-8
the double-single azimuth matches native double precision within 1e-8 rad
